description: Helps you decide how to ask a happy customer for a testimonial, from the customer's name, company, success story and the type of testimonial you want. Optional role, relationship, intended use, incentive, your product and business model fit it to the customer. Returns a request email, interview questions for the customer's role and sector, quote drafts for the customer to edit and a sign off checklist. It uses your product name when you give it and says so when you do not. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of case_study_generator when you need a testimonial request, interview questions and quote approval. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge, so the advice fits it. If omitted, it is read from your text and the answer says how. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

customer_company.description: The customer's company. Format is text. For example, "an approved anonymous manufacturer".

customer_name.description: The customer's name. Format is text. For example, "an approved anonymous manufacturer".

customer_role.description: The customer's job title. Format is text. For example, "finance director".

customer_status.description: Ask whether the customer is active or cancelled before a testimonial request. A confirmed typed fact takes precedence over cancellation wording. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "active".

incentive.description: Optional: what you are offering in return. Format is text. For example, "no incentive offered".

publication_approval.description: Optional confirmed written approval for this exact customer name, figures, quote and intended use. Ask before publication. A draft cannot grant customer permission. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "approved".

relationship_context.description: How long they have been a customer and the key interactions. Format is text. For example, "quarterly review completed with the finance lead".

success_story.description: A short description of their success with your product. Format is text. For example, "Company-reported pilot reduced approval time from 12 to 9 days in October 2026.".

testimonial_type.description: The kind of testimonial you need. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "written_quote".

use_case.description: Where the testimonial will be used (the website or a sales deck, for example). Format is text.

your_product.description: Optional: your product or service name, used in the answer. Without it the answer says so and shows a placeholder. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

name: testimonial_capture
title: Testimonial Capture
